rule: Optional/deferred ideas and unresolved questions. Nothing here is a minimum obligation. Each lead preserves the evidence trail that made it interesting.

leads.title: napari interop (reader plugin / embedded renderer)
leads.detail: Once the project format is stable, an npe2 reader plugin ('open this project in napari') reuses napari's rendering without making napari the coordinate authority. Watch napari's axis_labels/units adoption: 0.5.0 added the fields but 'napari is not using this information' yet (S3).
leads.deferred_because: Embedding napari couples us to its plugin/Qt machinery and its evolving transform internals (S5b showed a decomposition fix as late as 0.5.0).

leads.title: Vendor-proprietary formats via Bio-Formats / bioformats2raw
leads.detail: CZI/ND2/LIF support via the bioformats2raw conversion path into OME-Zarr keeps the in-app reader boundary narrow (S1 lists bioformats2raw as an NGFF implementation).
leads.deferred_because: Java dependency and large conversion surface; out of the team's testable boundary. Revisit if the group's instruments demand it.

leads.title: NGFF 0.5 / 0.6 evolution tracking
leads.detail: tifffile 2026.5.2 already moved ZarrTiffStore multiscales output to NGFF 0.5 / zarr format 3 (S12 Revisions); the ome/ngff repo continues 0.5 development. Our writer targets 0.4 until 0.5 reader support is cheap; re-check spec diffs before pinning a writer version.
leads.unresolved: Exact 0.5 deltas relevant to us (ome/ label metadata) were not diffed in this stage.

leads.title: SQLite single-file project store
leads.detail: Bounded alternative to the JSON directory: transactional atomicity across documents, worse human diffability. Trigger: field evidence of torn saves from W4-style testing on the lab NAS.
leads.deferred_because: Directory+rename meets the requirement if filesystem semantics cooperate; SQLite complicates bundle diffing for a six-person team.

leads.title: Automatic segmentation assist (StarDist/CellPose-style) and registration
leads.detail: Brief lists these as opportunities. QuPath's docs show a mature integration pattern (deep-learning pages, LabeledImageServer for ground-truth export) that we could copy later; masks we produce would be derived images with op records.
evidence: QuPath docs nav captured 2026-10-06 (deep-learning section listing)
leads.deferred_because: Not minimum scope; heavy model dependencies.

leads.title: Web sharing of bundles (vizarr-style client rendering)
leads.detail: OME-Zarr output makes a later read-only web view nearly free (S1 lists vizarr as purely client-side).
leads.deferred_because: Desktop-first brief; collaboration beyond bundle exchange excluded from minimum scope.

leads.title: OMERO / cloud storage backends
leads.detail: NGFF's ecosystem includes OMERO-to-Zarr services (S1 implementations list). A locator abstraction ('file://' vs 'omero://' URIs, QuPath-style serverBuilder idea from S8) would make this a drop-in later.
leads.deferred_because: Cloud services explicitly out of minimum scope.

leads.title: ImageJ/Fiji + BigDataViewer as partial reuse
leads.detail: Mature nD navigation and HDF5 chunk caching; the bigdataviewer-ome-zarr Fiji plugin reads OME-Zarr (S1).
leads.deferred_because: Java split for a small Python-capable team; project/annotation layer still ours.

leads.title: GPU-accelerated channel compositing
leads.detail: Optional once CPU compositing profiles slow on large multi-channel 3D views; napari's VisPy stack is the reference point.
leads.deferred_because: Envelope target is bounded access, not frame rate; optional GPU.

leads.title: Whole-slide pyramidal formats (SVS/NDPI/ZIF) via tifffile
leads.detail: tifffile reads Aperio SVS, Hamamatsu NDPI, ZIF etc. with documented caveats (NDPI 'works around this limitation ... performs poorly'; ZIF constraints) (S12 Notes). Only worth adding if the group receives slide scans.
leads.deferred_because: Outside the tested support boundary; per-format verification cost is real.

leads.title: Canonical annotation diff format for shared-storage review
leads.detail: Since bundles are exchanged via ordinary storage, a small JSON-Patch-style diff of annotation documents would let teammates review each other's edits. Depends on the canonical-JSON hashing proven in W3.
leads.deferred_because: Review workflow beyond minimum; keep canonical serialization stable from v1 to enable it.

leads.title: Orientation matrices beyond axis flips
leads.detail: v1 records only axis order + per-axis flips + sampling/origin; full affine orientation (e.g., stage-scan stitched tiles needing per-tile translation) needs the napari-style full affine and is recorded as a data op, never as silent import interpretation.
leads.unresolved: No source-backed design chosen yet for per-tile translations; would start from NGFF coordinateTransformations lists (S1 3.3).
